messages:
alex.k: Hi team — I'm Alex, first day in Eng. Quick security/setup q: my company laptop hasn't arrived yet, I'm on a personal Mac for the first week. Do I need to finish the Security 101 training and phish sim enrollment before I start using my personal device? Also travelling next Tue - is there a short-term device exemption process? :wave:

maya.peopleops: Welcome Alex :tada: You can use a personal Mac temporarily but we require MDM enrollment + disk encryption. Enroll here: https://redwood.example.com/mdm/enroll and upload a screenshot of the device showing enrolled. Security training + phish sim are due in 7 days (link sent to your email). If you're travelling, file an exception request with dates & device details and we'll route to security.

ravi.security: Hi Alex - quick checklist so you're unblocked: 1) Enroll in MDM ASAP 2) Enable FileVault on macOS (check with `fdesetup status`) 3) Enable SSO 2FA and register a hardware key if you have one. For a temporary exception we can allow a personal device under monitoring for up to 14 days; submit here: https://redwood.example.com/sec/exceptions. We can also ship a YubiKey if you want one.

alex.k: Thanks - when I ran `fdesetup status` earlier it said "Not Encrypted". Is it okay to enable FileVault now or should I wait until after MDM enrollment?

it-support: You can enable FileVault now, MDM will pick up the status once enrolled. Command to enable: `sudo fdesetup enable` (you'll be given a recovery key, save it somewhere secure). If you'd like remote help we can jump on a Zoom and walk through enroll + FileVault - ping me your availability.

maya.peopleops: Note on phish sim: you'll be auto-enrolled once your email is confirmed. If you're on a personal device we flag the account for follow-up training verification. Please complete the short assessment immediately after the training.

ravi.security: Important: we can't grant VPN or internal badge access until the device reports as compliant in MDM. For travel exceptions, we can issue a short-lived VPN token, but please submit the exception at least 24 hours before travel to avoid gaps.

alex.k: OK submitting the exception now (travel 2026-03-29 to 2026-04-02). Also quick Q: I'm contracting through DevShop for 4 weeks - do contractors follow the exact same onboarding for MDM/phish sim?

maya.peopleops: Yes, baseline security applies to contractors. If DevShop provides a corporate laptop, the vendor must enroll it in our MDM and share the asset ID. If using personal devices, the contractor must complete the same enrollment and training.

oncall-bot: reminder: Security training due in 6 days for user alex.k (link sent to registered email).

alex.k: Thanks all - tagging @ravi.security for YubiKey shipping if feasible. Appreciate the help :bow:
